ranked_bottlenecks.primary_contention_cause: Terminal throat convergence where 12 platform routes converge into 2 bi-directional main lines.
ranked_bottlenecks.mitigation_recommendation: Implement strict dynamic precedence dispatching; prioritize high-capacity express departures over delayed empty rake shuntings.

ranked_bottlenecks.primary_contention_cause: Grade-level diamond crossover conflicts between North suburban EMUs and West mainline express trains.
ranked_bottlenecks.mitigation_recommendation: Enforce staggered arrival scheduling; use automated CP-SAT headway buffers to avoid simultaneity.

ranked_bottlenecks.primary_contention_cause: Main line merge with Chennai Port freight bypass lines creating slow-speed entry friction.
ranked_bottlenecks.mitigation_recommendation: Optimize freight insertion windows into off-peak passenger headway gaps.

ranked_bottlenecks.primary_contention_cause: Limited platform turnaround buffer times for incoming suburban rakes forming return departures.
ranked_bottlenecks.mitigation_recommendation: Dynamic platform re-allocation across platforms 1 to 5 to avoid dwell spillover.

ranked_bottlenecks.primary_contention_cause: Scenario-injected 30 km/h speed restriction creating temporary train following queues.
ranked_bottlenecks.mitigation_recommendation: Dynamic speed profile advisories to leading trains to prevent full stop-and-go propagation.

ranked_bottlenecks.primary_contention_cause: Platform clearance delays for southern express arrivals crossing suburban main lines.
ranked_bottlenecks.mitigation_recommendation: Platform slot assignment optimization and departure gate control.

infeasible_boundary.resource_name: Chennai Central - Basin Bridge Down Main Throat
infeasible_boundary.root_cause_analysis: The complete capacity blockage of this critical non-redundant throat segment eliminates all physical directed paths between Chennai Central terminus platforms and downstream junction networks. Inbound trains cannot reach any platform and outbound trains cannot depart.
infeasible_boundary.dispatching_implication: This scenario represents a hard physical feasibility boundary. Mathematical retiming alone cannot find a valid schedule; human dispatchers must execute emergency short-terminations at Perambur / Avadi or route diversion via Chennai Beach.
